title: Zap turns itself off after a run of errors from one broken step
symptoms: Zap found turned off with no user change
Email that the Zap was turned off due to errors
Team or Enterprise owner warned 24 or 72 hours before shutoff
cause: Zapier turns a Zap off when 95 percent of its runs error over the last 7 days. Safely halted runs and runs handled by an error handler path do not turn the Zap off.
fix: Add an error handler path or a Filter that halts on expected bad data instead of erroring, fix the step, turn the Zap on, then replay failed runs.
apply: Zap editor > step > three dots icon > Add error handler
affected: All Zapier plans; grace period 24 hours on Team, 72 hours on Enterprise, as of 2026-10
